description: The phaser-flanger as a device: a mode (phaser, classic or flanger), a rate, a depth, a centre frequency, a delay, the classic phaser's stages, a feedback and a mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the sweep and the source of the classic phaser's worklet (the phaser of @audio/effect-phaser), with no panel and no audio in it.
name: phaser-device
